title: Hearty Algerian Lardons Lasagna
description: A rich and flavorful Algerian dish featuring lasagna sheets and lardons, perfect for a special date night, this recipe is a low-calorie friendly version of the classic dish.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the lasagna sheets according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, saute the chopped onion and minced garlic until softened.
Add the rendered lardons to the skillet and cook until crispy.
In a large bowl, combine the tomato sauce, ricotta cheese, and chopped parsley.
In a 9x13 inch baking dish, create a layer of tomato sauce.
Arrange 4 lasagna sheets on top of the sauce.
Spread half of the ricotta cheese mixture over the lasagna sheets.
Sprinkle with half of the shredded mozzarella cheese and half of the crispy lardons.
Repeat the layers, starting with the tomato sauce, then the lasagna sheets, the remaining ricotta cheese mixture, the remaining mozzarella cheese, and finally the remaining lardons.
Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
